title: When comparison keeps stealing steadiness after the mind has slipped
issueStatement: The mind keeps measuring worth and direction against other people. The problem now is not only temptation or pain, but what to do after the slip has already happened.
centralInsight: Gurbani returns dignity to remembrance, contentment, and the work in front of you. Gurbani keeps repair close to remembrance, humility, and return instead of theatre.
practicalReflection: The hardest field is the inner field. Win there first. Bring the mind back from the other person to the state of your own heart.
actionPrompt: Bring the mind back from the other person to the state of your own heart. Choose the next truthful return instead of rehearsing the failure.
